rioja.seoDescription: Discover Rioja on a private wine tour from Bilbao. Visit two family-owned wineries, explore medieval towns and enjoy a carefully selected lunch with local wine.
rioja.name: Private Rioja Wine Tour from Bilbao
rioja.catalogDescription: Two wineries, a medieval village and a table worth taking your time over. Discover Rioja through its wines, its landscapes and the people who bring them to life.
rioja.story:
Leave Bilbao behind for a day among the vineyards of Rioja, one of Spain’s most celebrated wine regions. This private experience brings together two winery visits, the medieval streets of Laguardia and a carefully selected local lunch with wine pairing.

We favour family-owned wineries, where the visit offers a closer connection to the people and decisions behind each bottle. Discover how the wines are made, taste different styles and hear the stories that connect them to the landscape.

Between visits, take in the vineyards and explore Laguardia, a hilltop village of stone streets, historic buildings and views across Rioja Alavesa. Your guide will introduce you to the region’s history and everyday life, giving context to what you see and taste.

Lunch is part of that discovery: regional cooking, seasonal ingredients and time to enjoy the food and conversation.

Whether you are discovering Rioja for the first time or already know your way around a wine list, we adapt the day to your interests. If there is a particular producer or iconic winery you would love to visit, tell us when you enquire.

costa-vasca.seoTitle: Private Basque Coast Tour from Bilbao | Gaztelugatxe, Mundaka & Gernika | GOXO
costa-vasca.seoDescription: Discover Gaztelugatxe, Mundaka and Gernika on a private Basque Coast tour from Bilbao, with hotel pick-up and an optional traditional asador lunch.
costa-vasca.name: Private Basque Coast Tour from Bilbao
costa-vasca.catalogDescription: Dramatic coastal views, fishing villages and the stories behind Basque identity. Discover Gaztelugatxe, Mundaka and Gernika with a local guide, at your own pace.
costa-vasca.story:
Leave Bilbao for a day along the Basque Coast, where the Atlantic landscape and the people who live beside it tell a shared story. This private experience connects San Juan de Gaztelugatxe, the fishing village of Mundaka and the historic town of Gernika.

At Gaztelugatxe, the famous Game of Thrones location, take in the views of the hermitage and its winding stone bridge from the lookout. If you would like a more active visit, we can arrange the walk down to the coast and up the steps to the hermitage, subject to access availability and conditions. During summer, this option comes with an earlier hotel pick-up to make the most of the cooler morning hours.

Continue to Mundaka, one of the most beautiful coastal towns where fishing traditions and surf culture meet around a small harbour. Explore its streets, hear stories of coastal life and enjoy views towards the Urdaibai estuary.

In Gernika, discover the history and symbols that make this town central to understanding the Basque Country. Your guide connects its past with the culture and everyday life of the region today.

For a longer experience, stay for lunch at a traditional Basque asador. With food cooked over the grill and ingredients chosen for their quality, this is one of the most characteristic ways to enjoy Basque gastronomy.

Discover the Casco Viejo through its food, its wine and the places where locals gather. Over three hours, your guide takes you through the Old Town’s streets to six carefully selected bars and restaurants, combining local favourites with tucked-away places you would be unlikely to find on your own.

Enjoy a selection of pintxos accompanied by drinks chosen to complement the flavours along the way. Discover different ingredients and ways of cooking, hear the stories behind the food and learn how to find your way around a Basque pintxo bar with confidence.

Between tastings, explore the streets and squares of the Casco Viejo. Your guide shares the history, customs and everyday details that help you understand Bilbao beyond its landmarks, with time for questions and conversation along the way.

All planned pintxos and drink pairings are included. The experience is private to your group, and we adapt the selection to your tastes and dietary requirements wherever possible. Vegetarian, gluten-free and non-alcoholic alternatives can be arranged in advance.

bilbao-cultura.seoDescription: Explore the Guggenheim Museum, Bilbao’s riverside and Old Town on a private four-hour tour with a local guide. Museum admission included, with optional lunch.
bilbao-cultura.name: Private Bilbao City Tour & Guggenheim Museum Visit
bilbao-cultura.catalogDescription: Begin inside the Guggenheim, follow the river through Bilbao’s transformation and discover the streets where the city’s story began.
bilbao-cultura.story:
Discover Bilbao through its art, architecture and everyday life on a private experience with a local guide. Over four hours, explore the Guggenheim Museum, walk along the river and continue into the Casco Viejo, connecting the city’s different identities along the way.

Begin with a guided visit inside the Guggenheim, with admission included. Spend approximately one and a half hours discovering selected masterpieces on display, discussing the ideas behind them and exploring the building itself as a work of architecture.

Outside the museum, follow the river through a city shaped by industry and reinvention. Your guide shares the stories behind the architecture, bridges and public spaces, helping you understand how Bilbao became the city you see today.

Finish in the Old Town, where the streets and squares reveal Bilbao’s earlier history and the daily life that continues around it. Hear local stories, discover corners you might otherwise overlook and leave with recommendations for the rest of your stay.

If you would like to continue over food, extend the experience with pintxos in the Casco Viejo or a restaurant meal selected around your tastes. Seafood, grilled meat or a Michelin-starred restaurant can be explored according to your interests and availability.

san-sebastian-getaria.seoTitle: Private San Sebastián & Getaria Tour from Bilbao | GOXO
san-sebastian-getaria.seoDescription: Discover San Sebastián and Getaria on a private tour from Bilbao, with hotel pick-up, a local guide and lunch at a restaurant chosen around your tastes.
san-sebastian-getaria.name: Private San Sebastián & Getaria Tour from Bilbao
san-sebastian-getaria.catalogDescription: The elegance of San Sebastián, the fishing heritage of Getaria and a memorable lunch by the Basque Coast. A private day of local culture, coastal landscapes and food worth travelling for.
san-sebastian-getaria.story:
Leave Bilbao for a day discovering two different sides of the Basque Coast. This private experience combines a guided visit to San Sebastián with the fishing town of Getaria and a carefully selected lunch.

Begin in San Sebastián, known locally as Donostia. Walk through the Ensanche, where elegant facades and broad avenues might make you feel you have stepped into Paris. Visit the Cathedral, explore the streets and squares of the Old Town and stroll beside La Concha Beach.

Your guide connects these places with the stories of the city, from its past as a fashionable summer retreat to the local traditions that continue today. There is time to enjoy the views, ask questions and discover the details you might otherwise overlook.

Travel along the coast to Getaria, a town shaped by the sea, fishing traditions and the vineyards that surround it. Explore its streets and harbour, hearing stories of seafarers, local life and the people who have carried its name around the world.

Lunch is part of the experience. Choose a traditional Basque asador, where cooking over the grill takes centre stage, or explore a Michelin-starred restaurant option. We select the venue with you, according to your interests, budget and availability, so the meal feels as personal as the rest of the day.

For those with an interest in fashion and design, Getaria also offers the option of visiting the Cristóbal Balenciaga Museum. Tell us when you enquire so we can plan time for the visit alongside the rest of your experience.

multi-day.seoTitle: Private Multi-Day Basque Country & Rioja Tours | GOXO
multi-day.seoDescription: Plan a private multi-day experience in the Basque Country and Rioja, combining food, wine, local culture, outdoor adventures and time to unwind.
multi-day.name: Tailor-Made Private Tours of the Basque Country & Rioja
multi-day.catalogDescription: A few days to explore, connect and enjoy the things you love. Discover the Basque Country and Rioja through a private experience designed around you.
multi-day.story:
Give yourself time to discover the Basque Country beyond a single day. Starting with a conversation about your interests, travel dates and preferred pace, we create a private itinerary that connects the places, people and activities you would most like to experience.

Explore Bilbao’s art and local life, discover San Sebastián and the fishing towns of the coast, or spend a day among the vineyards and medieval villages of Rioja. Food and wine can run through the experience, with visits to family-owned wineries, local restaurants and independent producers who share the stories behind their work.

If you enjoy the outdoors, we can include hiking, birdwatching, surfing or other adventure activities suited to your interests and experience. Follow a coastal trail before meeting a local producer, or spend a morning observing wildlife before exploring a nearby village.

You can also balance activity with time to unwind. Follow a hike or surf session with a spa visit, or set aside a quieter afternoon for wellness and relaxation before a memorable dinner.

Your days can be active, relaxed or a balance of both. We plan the route, transport, meals and selected activities together, with specialist guides or instructors where appropriate. Spa visits and treatments can be arranged according to your preferences and availability.

Throughout the experience, the aim is to bring you closer to the Basque Country while giving you time to enjoy it properly. Every programme is personal, and all arrangements are agreed before you book.

multi-day.itineraryTitle: WHAT WOULD YOU LIKE TO DISCOVER?
itinerary: Food & Wine

Discover the region through pintxos, traditional asadores, selected restaurants and winery visits. Meet the people behind the food and wine, with time to understand their work and enjoy what they create.
Culture & Local Life
Explore cities and villages with a local guide, connecting well-known landmarks with everyday stories. Art, architecture, maritime heritage and local traditions can all form part of your itinerary.
Local Producers & Crafts
Visit independent producers, family businesses or local workshops according to your interests and availability. Discover how their work connects to the landscape and the culture around it.
Hiking & Nature
Explore coastal paths, countryside and natural landscapes on routes chosen around your walking experience and preferred level of activity.
Birdwatching
Spend time observing birds and discovering their habitats, with locations and timings selected around the season and local conditions. Specialist guiding can be arranged as part of your programme.
Surfing & Outdoor Adventures
Include a surf session or another outdoor activity with an appropriate local provider. We discuss your experience, confidence and interests before selecting suitable options.
Wellness & Relaxation

Make space to slow down. Enjoy a spa visit after a coastal hike or surf session, explore available treatments, or include a quieter afternoon between days of discovery. We select options around your preferences and the rhythm of your itinerary.
includes: The design and coordination of your private itinerary.
GOXO guiding for the days and visits specified in your programme.
Transport for the agreed route.
The meals, winery visits, tastings and activities listed in your proposal.
Specialist guides or instructors for selected activities, where agreed.
Spa access or wellness treatments, when selected and specified in your proposal.
Coordination of the reservations included in your programme.
A clear itinerary and price before you confirm.
sections: 1. Tell us about your plans

Share your dates, the number of people travelling, your interests and an indication of your budget. Let us know your ideal balance of activity and relaxation, and anything you would particularly love to include.
2. Shape the itinerary together
We suggest a route and a balance of activities, visits, meals and time to unwind. You can give feedback so we can refine the programme around what matters most to you.
3. Confirm the arrangements
Once availability has been checked, we send the agreed itinerary, inclusions, price and booking terms. You will know what is arranged before confirming.
4. Enjoy your time here
We coordinate the agreed programme and share the practical details you need for each day, so you can focus on the experience.
GOOD TO KNOW
Outdoor activities depend on the season, weather and local conditions. We select options around your experience and comfort level, with specialist providers where appropriate.
Spa access and treatments depend on the facilities available and their reservation conditions. We confirm what is included, any age restrictions and the time needed when planning your programme.
Please tell us about dietary requirements, allergies, mobility needs or any other considerations when planning your experience.
Some winery visits or specialist activities may involve other participants unless an exclusive arrangement has been confirmed. Spa facilities may also be shared with other guests.

faqs.question: How many days should we plan?
faqs.answer: Tell us how much time you have and what you would most like to discover. We will suggest a realistic route and pace, allowing time to enjoy each place.

faqs.question: Can we combine food and wine with outdoor activities?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your programme can bring together city visits, local producers, restaurant meals, wineries, hiking, birdwatching, surfing or other activities, according to your interests.

faqs.question: Can we include a spa after hiking or surfing?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can arrange an outdoor activity followed by time at a spa, or include wellness as a separate part of your programme. Access, treatments, timings and costs are confirmed in your proposal, subject to availability.

faqs.question: Do we need previous experience for the outdoor activities?
faqs.answer: It depends on what you choose. We discuss your experience and comfort level, then check suitable options with the relevant provider before confirming.

faqs.question: Can the programme be relaxed rather than active?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You can focus on cultural visits, food, wine, gentle walks and spa time, with space to pause and enjoy each day.

faqs.question: Are all meals, activities and spa treatments included?
faqs.answer: Your proposal specifies exactly which meals, drinks, visits, activities and wellness services are included. There is no fixed selection: we agree the programme with you before booking.

faqs.question: Can you adapt the experience for different interests within our group?
faqs.answer: Tell us what each person enjoys and any practical needs. We will discuss how to create a balanced itinerary that works for your group.

faqs.question: What happens if conditions affect an outdoor activity?
faqs.answer: We discuss the relevant arrangements before booking and review alternatives if conditions affect the programme. Any changes follow the terms agreed with you and the activity provider.

faqs.question: How far ahead should we enquire?
faqs.answer: Get in touch once you know your approximate dates. More notice gives us greater flexibility to coordinate wineries, restaurants, specialist activities and spa reservations, particularly during busy periods.

finalCta: Let’s create your Basque Country experience.
Tell us what draws you here, how much time you have and your ideal balance of discovery, activity and relaxation. Endika will help shape a private programme around your interests and pace.

aboutIntro: GOXO takes its name from the Basque word “goxo”, evoking something tasty, comforting and made with care.
That idea shapes the way I welcome you: through personal, thoughtful travel, connected to the place you are visiting.
Based in Bilbao, I create private food, wine and cultural experiences across the Basque Country and Rioja, shaped around your interests and your pace.
aboutCompany: I was born in Bilbao and studied Business, imagining I would follow a more conventional path. Instead, I spent more than eleven years travelling and working as a guide around the world. Travelling taught me that every place has a story worth listening to. Guiding taught me something no degree could: the difference between showing someone a place and making them feel they belong.
With wings to explore and roots to return to, I came home to Bilbao. My roots were the same, but my perspective had changed. Because leaving also changes the way we belong.

GOXO grew out of that homecoming: a desire to share my homeland with the same curiosity, care and generosity I look for when I travel. After so many years introducing travellers to other parts of the world, I wanted to share my own: the places I know, the people I trust and the stories that rarely appear in a guidebook. With time to enjoy them, in small groups and with care for the people who welcome us.
I still feel like a traveller, even now that I am the one welcoming others. And after finding so many open doors far from home, I wanted to open mine.

values.title: Welcoming you as I like to travel
values.body: Before being a host, I am a traveller. I welcome you with the warmth, generosity and natural ease I appreciate when I travel. I share what I know and leave room for your questions and spontaneous conversations. I want to do more than show you a place: I want to help you discover it.

values.title: Listening to care for every detail
values.body: Everyone has their own way of discovering the world. Before planning an experience, I want to understand your interests and the pace you enjoy. I take care of the details and shape the day around you, so you feel looked after while keeping the freedom to enjoy it your way.

values.title: Sharing places without taking them over
values.body: Enjoying a place also means respecting the people who live there. That is why I offer private experiences for small groups: time to talk and explore without turning places into a stage or unnecessarily disrupting everyday life.

values.title: Building connections that matter
values.body: Getting to know a place means meeting the people who make it what it is. I build trusted relationships with local people and businesses, seeking fair, lasting partnerships. These encounters offer a closer understanding of the Basque Country while respecting the work, time and knowledge of those who welcome us.

values.title: Discovering the richness of local life
values.body: For me, keeping things local goes beyond choosing local produce. It means listening to local musicians, learning a village’s history or stopping to talk with the people who keep it alive. I want to share a Basque Country best discovered slowly, through the richness of everyday life.

values.title: Looking beyond the postcard
values.body: I combine the places you have always wanted to see with lesser-known corners and stories that rarely appear in guidebooks. I plan routes and timings carefully to encourage a quieter visit. It is about widening your perspective and discovering what lies beyond the familiar.

values.title: Keeping our roots alive
values.body: Traditional crafts, independent shops and local ways of doing things give a place its identity. I choose people and places that retain their character and have something of their own to share. I want to help keep those roots alive in a world where so many places are starting to look alike.

values.title: Leaving a lighter footprint
values.body: Every journey and activity has an impact. I prioritise walking where it makes sense, reduce waste and disposable plastics, and seek lower-impact transport when available. Caring for our surroundings starts with everyday decisions.

values.title: Learning from nature and respecting its rhythms
values.body: Nature is more than a backdrop: it is a living environment. I adapt activities to the seasons and conditions, follow marked trails and local rules, and observe wildlife without disturbing it. I want to share these landscapes while respecting their limits and natural rhythms.

values.title: Giving something back
values.body: Sharing my homeland also means taking responsibility for it. I commit a share of GOXO’s profits to local social and environmental projects, so that growing the business also contributes to the wellbeing of the people who live here and the care of the land. Because travel can also be a way of giving back.

hostStory: I was born in Bilbao and spent more than eleven years travelling and working as a guide around the world. Guiding taught me the difference between showing someone a place and making them feel they belong.
I came home with the same roots and a different perspective. GOXO is my way of sharing the places I know, the people I trust and the stories that rarely appear in a guidebook.
After finding so many open doors far from home, I wanted to open mine.

faqs.question: How do I book a GOXO experience?
faqs.answer: Send your preferred dates, the number of guests and what you would like to discover. I will reply personally with availability and a proposal. Before you book, you will receive the itinerary, inclusions, final price, payment instructions and cancellation terms.

faqs.question: Are all GOXO tours private?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your GOXO guide and itinerary are reserved for your group, with no other guests added. Wineries, museums, restaurants and activity venues may be shared with other visitors unless an exclusive arrangement has been confirmed.

faqs.question: Where do we meet, and is transport included?
faqs.answer: Day trips to Rioja, the Basque Coast, and San Sebastián and Getaria include hotel pick-up in Bilbao and transport between stops. For Bilbao walking tours, we agree on a convenient meeting point and can meet at your hotel when practical. All arrangements are confirmed before booking.

faqs.question: What is included in the price?
faqs.answer: It depends on the experience and the options you choose. Your proposal clearly lists the guiding, transport, tickets, tastings, meals and drinks included, along with any optional extras and the final price.

faqs.question: Can you adapt the experience to our interests and walking pace?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell me what you enjoy, your preferred pace and any mobility needs. We will discuss a suitable itinerary and what can be adapted around your group, opening times and availability.

faqs.question: Can you accommodate dietary requirements or guests who do not drink alcohol?
faqs.answer: Please share any allergies, dietary requirements or drink preferences before booking. I will check suitable options with the venues, including vegetarian, gluten-free and non-alcoholic alternatives, and discuss any limitations before confirming.

faqs.question: What languages are available?
faqs.answer: GOXO guiding is available in English and Spanish. Let me know your preferred language when you enquire. For specialist activities, we will confirm the provider’s available languages when planning your itinerary.

faqs.question: What happens if the weather affects our plans, or we need to cancel?
faqs.answer: If conditions affect the itinerary, I will discuss suitable alternatives with you. Any changes, rescheduling or cancellations follow the terms provided before booking, including any specific conditions for restaurants, wineries or activity providers.

reasons.title: Welcoming you as I like to travel
reasons.body: Warmth, care and time to listen. I shape each private experience around your interests, so you feel welcome and free to enjoy it your way.

reasons.title: Local connections, real encounters
reasons.body: I introduce you to places I know, people I trust and the stories behind the region’s food, wine and everyday life.

reasons.title: Keeping our roots alive
reasons.body: I support independent businesses and seek fair, lasting partnerships with the people whose work gives this place its character.

reasons.title: Travel that gives back
reasons.body: I make responsible choices and commit a share of GOXO’s profits to local social and environmental projects.
